text: The shipper on TG-604227 asked why the shipment had not left Holmquay. The desk explained the berth queue and said the ETA confidence was low.
The linehaul from KRN carrying TG-604677 was cancelled for lack of a driver. The desk noted the delay and the shipper chose to wait.
Wyncliff closed for yard works. TG-604305 was held there and the shipper asked about options.
Shipper asked whether TG-604733 could be moved to Holmquay. The desk said no because Holmquay does not accept reroutes.
TG-604590 was delivered in Brackwater. The shipper confirmed receipt with no damage.
A shipper asked about the claim window for damaged pallets. The desk quoted 21 days from delivery.
TG-604118 was rerouted once before through Mavisgate after a rail delay. The shipper was happy with the result.
A shipper asked whether dangerous goods could ride with TG-604412. The desk said class 3 liquids need a prior booking.
The shipper on TG-604412 asked for a delivery window because the consignee closes at 17:00.
A shipper asked about the customs paperwork for a cross-border lane. The desk pointed to the customs checklist.
